title: Integrating AI Security with Cloud Storage Services

blocks.text: Cloud Storage is a service that allows you to store and organize data. You can granularly control access to this data and use it for data analysis, auditing, threat detection, etc., based on your organization's security and compliance requirements.

AI Security can be integrated with cloud storage solutions, such as Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3), Amazon Security Lake, and Azure Blob Storage services to store and manage your data logs. The integration enables AI Security to send the alert data logs to these cloud storage services.
Only users with the administrator role can configure cloud storage integrations.
